title: Create and accept project invitations
responsibility: Issue a one-day invitation and atomically accept it for its verified email address.

inputs.name: createInvitation.deps
inputs.description: This dependency bundle supplies the repository used for transaction reads and compare-and-swap writes, plus an optional clock used to timestamp the invitation. Its source adapter, cache, and repository authorization callback are required by the type but are not called by these two functions.

inputs.name: createInvitation.actor
inputs.description: This strictly parsed actor has an ID and name trimmed to 1–200 characters, an email of at most 320 characters normalized to lowercase, and emailVerified set to true. Creation requires this actor to be a project owner.

inputs.name: createInvitation.input
inputs.description: This strict object contains a project UUID, a valid email of at most 320 characters, and a writer, commenter, or viewer role; the email is lowercased before storage. Extra fields and the owner role are rejected.

inputs.name: acceptInvitation.deps
inputs.description: This dependency bundle supplies the repository used for transaction reads and compare-and-swap writes, plus an optional clock used to check expiry. Its source adapter, cache, and repository authorization callback are required by the type but are not called by these two functions.

inputs.name: acceptInvitation.actor
inputs.description: This strictly parsed actor has an ID and name trimmed to 1–200 characters, an email of at most 320 characters normalized to lowercase, and emailVerified set to true. Acceptance requires its normalized email to match the invitation email.

inputs.name: acceptInvitation.input
inputs.description: This strict object contains project and invitation UUIDs plus a 64-character lowercase hexadecimal code. Extra fields, uppercase hex, or any other code length are rejected.

outputs.name: createInvitation
outputs.type: Promise<{ id: `${string}-${string}-${string}-${string}-${string}`; projectId: string; expiresAt: string; code: string; }>
outputs.description: Resolves to an object with a random UUID invitation ID, the project UUID, an ISO expiry exactly 24 hours after the configured or system clock, and the 64-character lowercase hexadecimal plaintext code. The repository stores the code's SHA-256 digest with acceptedBy set to null, so the returned code is needed to accept the invitation.

outputs.name: acceptInvitation
outputs.description: Resolves to the project summary with the actor's role after acceptance. It creates a member only when none exists, retains an existing member's role, and marks the invitation accepted.

errors.name: CollaborationInputError
errors.description: The implementation throws CollaborationInputError instances with codes invalid-input, forbidden, invalid-invitation, or conflict; conflict follows five failed compare-and-swap attempts. Repository and Web Crypto rejections propagate, and creation can throw a RangeError if the configured clock produces an invalid date.
